rationale.ai-review: LLM judge evaluates SWE-agent patches against repository-grounded rubrics.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Explicit weighted rubric criteria ground detection alongside probabilistic judging.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: File-change criteria detect unnecessary edits and departures from requested scope.
rationale.framework: Defines a reusable rubric-generation, grading, and patch-selection pipeline.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and benchmarked the complete verifier on SWE-Bench Verified.
rationale.agentic: Evaluates artifact-level patches produced through multi-step SWE-agent rollouts.
rationale.metrics: Defines a weighted quality score aggregating binary rubric judgments.
rationale.risk-quality: Evaluates mitigation of patch correctness, scope, compatibility, and runtime defects.
